app_fee.value: There is no application fee for research degree applications; they can be submitted at any time.
app_fee.quote: Applications may be submitted at any time and there is no application fee.

fee_waiver.value: International PhD students pay tuition unless they hold a scholarship; the 2027 international scholarship round is closed.
fee_waiver.quote: International students must pay tuition fees ... unless sponsored or awarded a scholarship.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement appears on the UWA research admission pages fetched.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate Research School sets research English rules; the page for them could not be fetched (uwa.edu.au/study/PG-lang-req returns 404), so no score is stated for PhD applicants. The coursework table (6.5 IELTS) is not used because it is for coursework degrees.

notes: Official doctoral list (researchdegrees.uwa.edu.au/courses) has one PhD, Doctor of Philosophy (code 895qq), used for all fields; fields are separated by school and project listings. Application fee: the Research Degrees portal says there is no application fee. Fee waiver: the international HDR flyer (dated August 2024) says international students pay tuition unless sponsored or scholarship-funded. Deadlines: the 2027 international scholarship round closed on 15 September 2026; the next international round is expected in August 2027. The 2027 domestic round (close 31 October 2026) is for domestic students and UWA international graduates only.
